116-1074-4613.easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kiora's Follower is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
116-1074-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
116-1074-4613.description:
Activate King Macar using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.

783-1719-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-1719-2645-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2981-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2981-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

222-527-3899-4460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

833-3827-5607-5621.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
833-3827-5607-5621.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Arid Archway, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2557-4772-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

880-6763-7889.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-7889.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3413-4875-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-4871-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2292-4871-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Viscera Seer four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1453-4559-4779-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-4779-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2557-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2034-2342-3169-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Shaman en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-3585-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3168-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1003-4763-5231--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {R}.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2146-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
2146-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2292-4338-5929.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

803-4338-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

338-4506-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4506-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-1849-2034.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4970-5645-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4970-5645-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1283-2909.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {4}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

716-1304-4289-4618.notablePrerequisites:
Nature's Chosen attached to Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry does not have summoning sickness.
716-1304-4289-4618.description:
Activate Triton Cavalry by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nature's Chosen's first ability by paying {0}, untapping Triton Cavalry.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, targeting Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry triggers, returning Nature's Chosen to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Instill Energy, attaching it to Triton Cavalry.
Activate Triton Cavalry by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Triton Cavalry.
Cast Nature's Chosen by paying {G}, targeting Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Nature's Chosen, attaching it to Triton Cavalry.

185-1980-2103-3098.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on each odd-numbered turn, with at most {3}{U} available each even-numbered turn
185-1980-2103-3098.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve both Capture of Jingzhous, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast etiher Mystic Retrieval or Call to Mind by paying its mana cost, targeting either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval in your graveyard.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve both Call to Minds or Mystic Retrievals, returning Capture of Jingzhou and either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

927-1713.notablePrerequisites: An opponent does not control a creature that matches the color chosen with Lurebound Scarecrow.
927-1713.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Lurebound Scarecrow to an opponent who controls no creatures which match the color named by Lurebound Scarecrow.
When Lurebound Scarecrow's controller controls no creatures which match the color named by it, Lurebound Scarecrow triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Lurebound Scarecrow cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Lurebound Scarecrow triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1095-1887-2247-3516.notablePrerequisites:
Teferi has at least seven loyalty counters on it.
Ajani Steadfast has at least three loyalty counters on it.
1095-1887-2247-3516.description:
Activate Ajani Steadfast's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Ajani, the Greathearted's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Ajani Steadfast's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Ajani, the Greathearted's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing you to loot.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

224-1315-2366-2532-3470.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
224-1315-2366-2532-3470.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
The Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the Dryad Arbor token.
The Dryad Arbor token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

224-596-2119-4096.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
224-596-2119-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Darksteel Citadel and return Seat of the Synod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Seat of the Synod enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Seat of the Synod by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Seat of the Synod and return Darksteel Citadel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Darksteel Citadel enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Darksteel Citadel by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

690-1738-4961.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
690-1738-4961.description:
Cast Inscription of Abundance by paying {1}{G}, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's power.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

15-413-1339-4875.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-413-1339-4875.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Insect.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

1992-2744-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2744-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability by dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

202-1860-2173-2656-3189-3255.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 24.
You have not played land this turn.
202-1860-2173-2656-3189-3255.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for Bolas's Citadel, Emergence Zone, Repay in Kind, Lich, and any other card, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library in the order previously listed and losing half your life, rounded up.
Activate Commander's Sphere by sacrificing it, drawing a card.
Cast Bolas's Citadel by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}.
Play Emergence Zone from the top of your library.
Activate Emergence Zone by paying {1}, tapping, and sacrificing it.
Cast Repay in Kind from the top of your library by paying seven life.
Holding priority, cast Lich from the top of your library by paying 4 life.
Lich entering the battlefield, causing you to lose life equal to your life total.
Resolve the Repay in Kind, causing each player's life total to become equal to the lowest life total among all players.

328-2034-3260-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-2034-3260-4078.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-2034-3260-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

651-3588-4046.notablePrerequisites: Animal Boneyard must be attached to an untapped land.
651-3588-4046.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Tap the land equiped with Animal Boneyard, sacrificing Task Force and gaining life equal to its toughness.

738-3370-5004-5256.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Altar of Dementia.
Cathodion and Butcher of Malakir trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Butcher of Malakir's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
